strategy.name: NASDAQ Pullback (daily + hourly)
strategy.summary: Buys short dips in the NASDAQ 100 while it's in a long-term uptrend, sells on the bounce
rules: Only buy while NASDAQ's last daily close is above its 200-day average (no trades in downtrends)
Daily Pullback: buy at the next day's open when the 2-day RSI on daily candles closes below 30
Hourly Pullback: buy at the next hour's open when the 2-hour RSI on hourly candles closes below 10
Sell at the next open once a candle closes above its 5-candle average, or after 10 days / 14 hours
Safety stop 4x ATR below entry; risk 0.5% of the starting balance per trade; one trade per strategy at a time
Safety switch: pauses a strategy at -8% account drawdown, or if after 20+ live trades its win rate drops below 50% or profit factor below 1.0
strategy.evidence: Daily: 25-year test, 65-75% wins in both halves. Hourly: ~3-year test, 66% wins, PF 1.2-1.3
